title: Low degree coordinate mass
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and a nonnegative integer $k$, the low degree mass associated with $i$ is the sum of $\widehat f(S)^2$ over all subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ that contain $i$ and have cardinality at most $k$.
